summary.text: Mary Madison is a Democratic state representative who has represented Iowa House District 31 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Kevin DuBay.
Ballotpedia lists Madison's profession as minister.

paragraphs.text: Mary Madison's career experience includes working as a minister with an AME church, according to Ballotpedia.
Madison won the District 31 general election in 2022, defeating Justin Pearson (R), and won election again in 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session Madison was assigned to the Economic Growth, House Education, Environmental Protection, House Transportation and International Relations committees.
